human.name: Human
human.desc: Adaptable. The widest range of jobs.

saurian.name: Saurian
saurian.desc: Scaled and sturdy. Hits hard, weak to magic.

sylph.name: Sylph
sylph.desc: Long-eared forest folk. Fast and precise.

mossling.name: Mossling
mossling.desc: Small, furry and clever with tools and beasts.

squire.name: Squire
head: helm
hat
squire.desc: Sturdy all-rounder. Learns basic battle skills.

rogue.name: Rogue
head: hat
rogue.desc: Steals gil and gear. Hard to hit.

knight.name: Knight
head: helm
knight.desc: Armored front-liner that breaks enemy stats.

shadow.name: Shadow
head: hat
shadow.desc: Fast striker with veils and binding arts.

wyrmlancer.name: Wyrmlancer
head: helm
wyrmlancer.desc: Leaps from the sky and breathes elements.

brawler.name: Brawler
head: helm
hat
brawler.desc: Unarmed fighter who heals with chakra.

summoner.name: Summoner
head: hat
summoner.desc: Calls spirits that strike only enemies.

animist.name: Animist
head: hat
animist.desc: Calls on wild creatures to help.

tinker.name: Tinker
head: hat
tinker.desc: Tricks and gadgets that slow and confuse.

mossknight.name: Moss Knight
head: helm
mossknight.desc: Tough little knight with thorned blades.

chronomancer.name: Chronomancer
head: hat
chronomancer.desc: Bends time: haste, slow and stop.

illusionist.name: Illusionist
head: hat
illusionist.desc: Wide spells that strike every foe in range.

firstaid.name: First Aid
firstaid.desc: Small heal and cures poison and blind.

stonetoss.name: Stone Toss
stonetoss.desc: Throw a stone at a distant foe.

cure.name: Cure
cure.desc: Restores HP in a small area.

cura.name: Cura
cura.desc: Restores more HP in a small area.

raise.name: Raise
raise.desc: Revives a fallen ally with 25% HP.

esuna.name: Esuna
esuna.desc: Removes negative statuses in an area.

fire.name: Fire
fire.desc: Fire damage in a small area.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.desc: Ice damage in a small area.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.desc: Lightning damage in a small area.

fira.name: Fira
fira.desc: Strong fire damage in a small area.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.desc: Grant Protect to self or an adjacent ally.

manasiphon.name: Mana Siphon
manasiphon.desc: Drain MP from an adjacent foe.

shuriken.name: Shuriken
shuriken.desc: Throw a star at a distant foe.

flameveil.name: Flame Veil
flameveil.desc: Fire damage in a small area.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.desc: Grant Protect and Shell to self.

purify.name: Purify
purify.desc: Removes negative statuses in an area.

earthsmash.name: Earth Smash
earthsmash.desc: Shockwave that hits foes in an area.

revive.name: Revive
revive.desc: Revive an adjacent ally with 50% HP.

ironbody.name: Iron Body
ironbody.desc: Grant Protect and Regen to self.

sylphid.name: Sylphid
sylphid.desc: Wind spirit. Hits foes only; may Slow.

lumen.name: Lumen
lumen.desc: Spirit of light. Hits foes only.

lullaby.name: Lullaby
lullaby.desc: Puts foes in an area to Sleep.

stampede.name: Stampede
stampede.desc: A herd tramples foes in an area.

pratfall.name: Pratfall
pratfall.desc: Trip a foe so it cannot move.

mossguard.name: Mossguard
mossguard.desc: Grant Protect and Shell to self.

mossaid.name: Moss Aid
mossaid.desc: Heal self or an adjacent ally.

thornburst.name: Thornburst
thornburst.desc: Thorns hit adjacent foes and may poison.

aqua.name: Aqua
aqua.desc: Water damage in a small area.

aero.name: Aero
aero.desc: Wind damage in a small area.

stop.name: Stop
stop.desc: Chance to freeze a foe in time.

quicken.name: Quicken
quicken.desc: An ally takes the next turn.

prominence.name: Prominence
prominence.desc: Fire on every foe in a wide area.

glacier.name: Glacier
glacier.desc: Ice on every foe in a wide area.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.desc: Wind on every foe in a wide area.

starcross.name: Star Cross
starcross.desc: Holy light on every foe in a wide area.

salvemix.name: Salve Mix
salvemix.desc: Brewed salve: heals and cures poison.

counter.name: Counter
counter.desc: Strike back when hit by an adjacent attack.

autopotion.name: Auto-Potion
autopotion.desc: Drink a Potion when damaged (uses inventory).

returnfire.name: Return Fire
returnfire.desc: Shoot back at ranged attackers in range.

laststand.name: Last Stand
laststand.desc: Below 25% HP, gain Boost and Protect.

manashield.name: Mana Shield
manashield.desc: Damage is taken from MP first.

absorbmp.name: Absorb MP
absorbmp.desc: Gain MP equal to the cost of spells cast on you.

basic_strike.name: Strike
basic_strike.desc: A plain melee blow from the vessel.

basic_shot.name: Shot
basic_shot.desc: A plain ranged attack from the vessel.

basic_arcane.name: Spark
basic_arcane.desc: A plain bolt of power from the vessel.

basic_mend.name: Soothe
basic_mend.desc: A plain mending touch from the vessel.

basic_trick.name: Hinder
basic_trick.desc: A plain hex that may Slow a foe.

MISSIONS.brief: Grimkin have taken the old bridge at Briar Ford and are robbing travelers. Drive them off.

MISSIONS.name: Ashfang Raiders
MISSIONS.brief: A rival clan, the Ashfang, has seized the quarry road. Their leader Korr will not leave without a fight.

MISSIONS.name: The Hag of the Hollow
MISSIONS.brief: Villagers vanish in Mirewood Hollow. Something old lives in the bog. Find it and end it.

town.desc: Your home town. Shop, bazaar and pub.
